attchmntText: Please find enclosed herewith Performance Update for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Godrej Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The company reported that exports grew by 10 percent in both the second quarter and the first half of fiscal year 2027, with exports accounting for 27 percent of segment revenue. The business received 59 awards during the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The performance update includes financial data for various segments including Building and Business, Growth Capital, and others, with specific metrics such as PBIT for the Chemicals business and booking value for GPL. The results are available as an enclosure to the regulatory filing.

attchmntText: Godrej Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Godrej Industries Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board noted the Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors Kalyaniwalla & Mistry LLP. The report carries an unmodified conclusion for both Standalone and Consolidated results. The consolidated results include sixty one subsidiaries, one associate, and twenty one joint ventures. These entities reflect total assets of Rs. 128,783.47 crore as at September 30, 2026. Total revenues for these entities were Rs. 5,916.32 crore for the quarter and Rs. 10,183.23 crore for the half year. Net profit after tax was Rs. 302.69 crore for the quarter and Rs. 829.45 crore for the half year. Four subsidiaries and three joint ventures were not reviewed by their auditors. Their results are considered not material to the Group.

attchmntText: Godrej Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Company Announcement- Primary Infusion of capital in Godrej Capital Limited by Temasek Group.
voiceSummary: Godrej Industries Limited announced that Temasek Holdings via Jongsong Investments Pte Ltd will invest 2,500 crore in Godrej Capital. This infusion values Godrej Capital at up to 28,000 crore. Post-transaction, the Group retains approximately 80% ownership. Godrej Capital targets 1 lakh crore in Assets Under Management by 2031. The company currently holds 35,000 crore in AUM as of October 31, 2026. Founded in 2020, Godrej Capital provides home loans, personal loans, and other financial services across India. The transaction is subject to requisite regulatory approvals.
